description:
[Servers] One Rust server ConVar in full. Everything `/servers/config/convars` returns for one ConVar, plus `game_mode_values` (the value each of Rust's
own game modes sets it to at startup, when it does) and `fixed_by_game_mode` (true when any game mode decides it
from the mode prefab, so server.cfg can't change it while a mode is set).
name: get_server_convar
title: One Rust server ConVar in full
